(user, 2026-09-13); the COOHAVIOR station a team stands for is _v4_station.
Everyone starts in bedroom_0, packed around the centroid of its largest free
region (decision: user, 2026-09-12). The room is the most open one measured as
traversable floor (no-object map) minus the footprints of every object the scene

edits keep, eroded by the largest robot footprint; admissible area per room, m2: bedroom_0 8.2, playroom_0 7.1, television_room_0 6.0, corridor_0 5.1, childs_room_1 3.2, bathroom_1 2.9, childs_room_0 1.9, bathroom_0 1.3, closet_1 0.2, closet_0 0.2, closet_2 0.1, storage_room_1 0.1.

clearance = sum of half-footprints + 0.15 m, so sets_<k> is the first 3k robots of
sets_5. Each Crazyflie spawns at z = 1.2 m directly above its own team's Jackal.
